QuestInfo.name: World of Falling Leaves
QuestInfo.0: It's Autumn in Maple World and Cassandra has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Hold on to the Yellow Maple Leaf you got from Cassandra for 30 minutes to turn it into a Red Autumn Maple Leaf. #bRemember: the Maple Leaf will disappear if you log out before then!
QuestInfo.2: Take a moment to enjoy Autumn every day!
